a.xlink:title: Whether the backing store is reachable, reconnecting when it is not.
True if the password matches the stored credential, whether legacy salt+hash or scrypt.
Opens the server's main database connection; false when it cannot be opened.
Read a value, preferring a per-run override set with setOverride().
Derive the scrypt verifier for the given password, salt and cost parameters. Empty on failure.
True if the stored value is not in the scrypt format (legacy salt+hash).
Parse a stored "$scrypt$..." string into its components.
True if the scrypt cost parameters are acceptable for server and client use.
